text: {"lessons":["My account rose substantially and then fell without any trades, so I should expect volatility and avoid treating a recent move as a forecast.","Because I rarely check or trade, I should make deliberate decisions when I review the account rather than react to a single month's change.","I should not hold a losing position just to avoid admitting a mistake; I can reassess it objectively and sell if my reason for owning it no longer holds."]}
